title: Kumpel und Hütte: choose the visual world
question: Your brief pins the world (Nordic winter room, red-brick Zechensiedlung, colliery warmth, oak kitchen table). The roll decides its structure. Keep the Haushaltsbuch, take the kitchen-table pick, or re-roll.

options.label: Das Haushaltsbuch
options.lineage: The ruled household ledger Ruhrgebiet families kept in the kitchen drawer
options.thesis: A home that keeps honest books: calm linen pages, every promise written as a ruled entry, totals underlined twice.
materials: linen paper with faint ruled lines
options.viewport: Big Vollkorn headline 'Nicht Heim. Nicht allein. Einfach Zuhause!', a real kitchen photo in a pale-oak frame, and a brick-red call button with the phone number spelled out.
options.risk: Ledger ruling can turn bureaucratic if used everywhere; it must stay on the numbers and the steps.

raised.raise: Every photo is seamed to an honest caption saying what it really shows (our kitchen, Conny fitting handrails), never a stock mood.
Palette discipline: exactly four named colors on linen and oat, each with one job (red door = act, ochre = warmth/numbers, moss = garden/trust, coal = text).
Numbers set in tabular lining figures so 570 + 200 + 200 = 970 lines up like a sum on paper.
Explicit state vocabulary: current page, open FAQ, and focus are always drawn, never implied by color alone.

options.label: Der gedeckte Küchentisch
options.lineage: The lit kitchen table with coffee already on
options.thesis: Every page is a table set for one more guest: oak surfaces, lamp-glow ochre, warm photography leading.
options.viewport: Full-width warm photo of the real kitchen with the headline on a linen card like a place setting.
options.risk: This is the brief's literal reading and the look most runs in this category land on; it depends on photos the site does not have many of.

options.label: Memory quilt atlas
options.thesis: Each resident's history as a stitched block.
options.case: Needs resident stories the site must not invent; loses on product clarity and truth.
options.kept: Honest captions seamed to every photo.

options.label: Pickling brine calendar
options.case: Charming but seniors and relatives do not identify with fermentation; loses both axes.
options.kept: Kraft-label warmth is already in the oat neutrals; nothing further borrowed.

options.label: Spy dossier title sequence
options.case: Surveillance is the opposite of dignity; loses both axes.
options.kept: One orchestrated arrival per page instead of scattered motion.

options.label: Four-shade handheld field
options.case: Tiny pixel type is hostile to older eyes; loses both axes.
options.kept: Total palette discipline: four colors, each with one job.

options.label: Collider event display
options.case: Cold and technical; loses both axes.
options.kept: Tabular figures so prices sum visibly.

options.label: One-bit desktop
options.case: Computer nostalgia, not home; loses both axes.
options.kept: Explicit, always-drawn states for current page, open answers, and focus.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A senior-living site as the category ships it: stock photo hero, trust badges, card grid, big CTA.
canonCard.viewport: Smiling-seniors hero, three icon cards, contact band.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every Pflegeheim site, which is exactly what the brief refuses.
